2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Miami attacks a Las Vegas offense missing its toughest coverage problem
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: Las Vegas will play without Brock Bowers, removing the Raiders’ most difficult matchup piece and placing more responsibility on Ashton Jeanty and the remaining receiving group. Miami enters without a game-status injury designation and can pressure the Raiders by winning early downs and forcing predictable passing situations. Jeanty’s return gives Las Vegas a route to stay balanced, but the Raiders need sustained efficiency rather than isolated chunk plays. Miami’s tackling and ability to prevent a slow, possession-heavy game will shape whether Bowers’ absence becomes decisive.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Miami has the cleaner availability picture, while Las Vegas needs Jeanty, efficient early downs and complementary targets to keep the Dolphins from dictating obvious passing situations.
